How does Sonora know what is playing?

Music apps share what they play with the system through a media session. With notification access, Sonora reads that session: the album art, the title and whether it is playing. Nothing leaves your device.
Why does Beat Pulse ask for audio access?
To pulse with the beat, Sonora listens to the sound your device is already playing. It never uses the microphone and never records or stores audio.
